_about: Expected access per (route, method). allow = must NOT get 401/403/404; hide = must be refused, 404 accepted; every other caller must get 401/403. object = the seeded world object the URL id names when the cross-tenant / cross-owner refusal is asserted, else null. Generated from observed behaviour on 2026-11-13; edit by hand from now on. See test_access_matrix.py. pinned = an allowed caller whose exact status is fixed (BUG: a real app fault the test fails on once fixed; ENV: a test-environment limit such as AI or storage switched off). Flags: HOLE (a real gap), INTENT-UNCLEAR (current behaviour recorded, intent unconfirmed), UNCOVERED (nobody can be allowed in this world, so no fence is proved), STATE (the owner is refused for a state reason, so the 403 is not a fence). NOT COVERED by this matrix: maker-checker inside payment runs and credits (the second-person approval rule) is M4 own test work.
